evidence.detail: The class exposes only static methods accepting R28 ObjectDefinition plus object id; it has no unrelated state or target type.
ObjectDefinition invokes rs/c/a/a.a(definition,id) only when its exact definition-mode enum equals the preserved OLDSCHOOL constant.

Both override methods mutate only ObjectDefinition.an, the integer model-id array. The large method contains an approximately 680-id lookup table assigning replacement model-id arrays, and the wrapper performs a second eight-id model-array correction pass.

No name, action, size, collision, recolor, animation or other ObjectDefinition field is written by this class, so the semantic role is specifically old-school object model overrides rather than generic definition patching.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the OLDSCHOOL-only ObjectDefinition model-id override table. No broader object-definition semantics are claimed.
